useful_god.rationale: Day Master Fire is weak; Wood balances the chart.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 4th sign from the Moon.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun and Mercury are both in Virgo.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon and Mars are both in Leo.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Leo, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is exalted in Virgo and in the 1st house from the Lagna, a kendra.

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Scorpio, neither its own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) nor its exaltation sign (Cancer).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Leo, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is exalted in Libra but in the 2nd house from the Lagna; Sasa needs a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Aquarius; its lord Saturn is in the 2nd house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Aries; its lord Mars is in the 12th house.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Leo; its lord Sun is in the 1st house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: No planet is in its debilitation sign.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Virgo): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Cancer): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Virgo): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Cancer): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Virgo): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Cancer): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Virgo): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Cancer): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty.

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Libra): Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Leo): Mars and Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Libra): Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Leo): Mars and Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Libra): Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Leo): Mars and Venus (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Venus. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: Saturn; in the 12th: Mars. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two planets stand in each other's signs.

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 12th from the Lagna, 1st from the Moon and 1st from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: All seven planets lie on one side of the Rahu–Ketu axis.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Gemini): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Taurus): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Venus and the 11th lord Moon are linked: Venus and Moon are both in Leo.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Venus (Leo) and the 10th lord Mercury (Virgo) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.
